old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of stacked logs engulfed in flames against a stark black background. The fire is concentrated on one particular area, where the flames dance vigorously. The smoke rises steadily from the burning wood, adding a sense of movement and depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is intense and dramatic, emphasizing the destructive power of fire. There are no animals or characters present in the video; the focus remains solely on the burning wood and the interplay of light and shadow.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a wooden structure engulfed in flames against a stark black background. The wood appears to be part of a larger framework, possibly a roof or a section of a building, with visible planks and beams. The fire is concentrated on one particular area, where the flames dance vigorously, casting dynamic shadows and illuminating the charred wood beneath. As the video progresses, the intensity of the flames fluctuates, with some frames showing more vigorous burning while others depict a calmer state. The smoke rises steadily from the burning wood, adding a sense of movement and depth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is intense and dramatic, emphasizing the destructive power of fire. There are no animals or characters present in the video; the focus remains solely on the burning wood and the interplay of light and shadow.
caption: The video captures a pile of split wood against a pure black background, with orange flames burning on the pieces. A diagonal plank on the left rests on a front horizontal log, while a cylindrical log sits behind and another plank leans right. Early on, a tall orange flame column rises above the left plank's top edge, accompanied by a separate tongue floating higher. This column wavers, narrows, and fades into thin dark wisps with faint tips by the excerpt's middle. A flame running along the plank's front face and onto the bottom log persists throughout, flickering with a thin line tracking diagonally. Later, new, brighter tongues re-emerge from the top corner, growing upward as the high detached flame disappears. The wood pieces remain stationary, their grain and char marks fixed, while the flames and smoke provide all visible motion.
